meaning: Fault detected in the outdoor sensor (short circuit); the indicator lights flash a specific pattern. The control is programmed to calculate the outdoor temperature at -8 F (-22 C) and control the supply temperature accordingly. The control only allows the valve to operate as high as the supply maximum setting.
checks: Follow standard testing procedures to confirm the problem (sensor testing instructions are in Data Brochure D 001). If a wiring fault is suspected, carefully check all external wiring and wiring connections. After repair, press the Test button to cycle the control through the test routine and confirm correct operation has been restored.
